params.query:
# radar-backtest cordis_sparql dataset=grant_type page
PREFIX eurio: <http://data.europa.eu/s66#>
SELECT (REPLACE(STR(?grant), "^.*/", "") AS ?grant_uuid) ?value
WHERE {
  ?grant a eurio:Grant ; eurio:hasFundingSchemeType ?s . ?s eurio:code ?value .
}
ORDER BY ?grant ?value
LIMIT 10000 OFFSET 40000
